title: SSH keys and known hosts
whyItMatters: The .ssh folder holds private keys that log into servers, git hosts and cloud machines, plus known_hosts listing every host connected to. A copied key with no passphrase is immediate access.
source: OpenSSH manual pages: user keys default to ~/.ssh/id_* with known_hosts, config and authorized_keys in the same folder: https://www.openssh.com/manual.html
notes: id_* files without a .pub suffix are private keys. known_hosts reveals which servers were used even when the keys are gone. authorized_keys shows which other keys may log in as this user.
